notes: Fixed a fault that stopped the app launching. A file added in 1.1.220 was never included in the packaged build, and the app loads it at startup, so versions 1.1.220 through 1.1.224 would fail to start after installing. Anyone on one of…

Added a check that traces every file the app loads at startup and fails the build if any of them would be missing from the package. Nothing previously covered the gap between the source being correct and the shipped copy containing it.
